title: Resident Trust Fund Accounts — Written Authorization, Admission and Tier Placement
content:
## Clause

Keystone Ridge holds a resident's money under the Resident Trust Fund Accounts only on the written authorization of the resident or legal representative, and depositing funds with the center can never be required as a condition of admission; a resident may decline and manage money personally. The tier follows the records: a Medicaid resident is one whose Medical Assistance case is eligible, the representative payee tiers apply while the center is the resident's SSA representative payee, and the guardianship tiers apply while a court-appointed guardian of the estate is on file. Funds are kept apart from the center's operating accounts, and no fee is ever charged for holding or managing them.

## How an account starts

An account is set up awaiting the resident's authorization. When the resident or legal representative signs the written authorization for the center to hold funds, it becomes active; when the resident or legal representative declines to deposit funds with the center, it is recorded as declined.

## Tier placement from the records

| What the records show | Medicaid part of the tier | Who directs the funds |
|---|---|---|
| Medical Assistance case eligible | Medicaid | — |
| no eligible Medical Assistance case | Non-Medicaid | — |
| the center is the resident's SSA representative payee | — | Representative Payee |
| a court-appointed guardian of the estate is on file | — | Guardianship |
| the resident, or an agent under power of attorney, directs the funds | — | Self-Directed |

A resident with an eligible Medical Assistance case and a guardian of the estate on file is therefore in the Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Guardianship tier; a resident with no eligible case for whom the center is SSA representative payee is in the Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Representative Payee tier.

## Points of judgement

- The person who may authorize a withdrawal follows the tier: the resident or an agent under power of attorney in the self-directed tiers, the center as payee on the resident's request in the payee tiers, and the guardian in the guardianship tiers.
- A statement of the account never shows a holding or management fee.
